title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Obstructed Sensor May Cause Unexpected Braking (183 affected)
summary: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2024 H3-45 and 2022-2024 H3-45 VIP motorcoaches equipped with Prevost Driver Assist.  The radar sensor may be obstructed by an incorrect front bumper trim panel, causing the driver assist system to not function properly.

title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Windows & Interior Lashing Rail Cargo May Detach (131 affected)
summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter and 2021 Freightliner Sprinter vehicles.  The topcoat paint formula may cause the windows and interior lashing rails to be insufficiently bonded to the vehicle.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Braking May Require Increased Force (2,797 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2024 GLE 450e Plug-in Hybrid (PHEV) vehicles.  Due to a software error in the electronic stability program (ESP), the force required to stop the vehicle may increase, possibly requiring an extended distance to stop.

title: Spartan Fire, LLC: Overloaded Electrical System May Cause Fire (69 affected)
summary: Spartan Fire, LLC (Spartan Fire) is recalling certain 2020-2023 Spartan Fire S-180 Pumper Fire Apparatus, Smeal Aerial Fire Apparatus, Smeal Pumper Fire Apparatus, and Spartan Fire Ladder Tower Aerial Fire Apparatus trucks.  In the event of a short circuit or wiring failure, the firmware in the vehicle multiplex system may fail to shut off the output pin, resulting in overloaded electrical circuits.

title: Gillig, LLC: Inadequate Rear Axle Hub Lubrication (34 affected)
summary: Gillig, LLC (Gillig) is recalling certain 2023 Low Floor vehicles.  An inadequate amount of lubricant in the rear axle hubs may cause failure of the rear drive axles.

title: Eldorado National- California, Inc.: Transmission May Separate from Driveshaft (443 affected)
summary: Eldorado National-California, Inc (Eldorado National-California) is recalling certain 2019-2023 Axess and EZR vehicles.  The transmission yoke may separate, resulting in driveshaft separation and a sudden loss of drive power.

title: Gillig, LLC: Incorrect Fuse May Overheat and Cause Fire (3,626 affected)
summary: Gillig, LLC (Gillig) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Low Floor vehicles.  The rearview mirror electric adjustment system may have been manufactured with an incorrect fuse.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: Rear Spoiler May Obstruct Center Brake Light (53 affected)
summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Porsche 718 Cayman GTS 4.0, 2024 Porsche 718 Boxster S, and 718 Boxster GTS 4.0 vehicles.  The rear electronic control unit (ECU) may allow the spoiler to raise up too high.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Incorrectly Adjusted Headlights (20,051 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Infiniti QX60 vehicles.  When driving at certain high speeds, the Adaptive Front-Light System (AFS) may incorrectly adjust the headlights downward.

title: Terberg Benschop B.V.: Steering Linkage May Loosen and Detach (3 affected)
summary: Terberg Benschop B.V. (Terberg Benschop) is recalling certain 2021-2022 YT193 terminal tractors.  Paint on the mounting surface of the steering linkage can wear off, which may cause the bolt to become loose or break, resulting in a loss of steering control.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: Incorrect GAWR on Certification Label/Part 567 (53 affected)
summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2024 VN and VHD vehicles equipped with size 295/75 or 385/65 Continental tires on the front axle.  The Gross Axle Weight Rating (GAWR) listed on the vehicle certification label is incorrect, which can allow the vehicle to be overloaded.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Textron Specialized Vehicles: Water May Damage Battery (67 affected)
summary: Textron Specialized Vehicles (Cushman) is recalling certain 2024 Cushman Hauler Pro LSV vehicles.  Water may enter the battery composite module and damage electrical circuits.

title: Kovatch Mobile Equipment Corp.: Overloaded Electrical System May Cause Fire (22 affected)
summary: Kovatch Mobile Equipment Corp. (KME) is recalling certain 2020 Severe Service, Predator, and Spartan MetroStar trucks.  In the event of a short circuit or wiring failure, the firmware in the vehicle multiplex system may fail to shut off the output pin, resulting in overloaded electrical circuits.

title: Ferrara Fire Apparatus, Inc.: Overloaded Electrical System May Cause Fire (6 affected)
summary: Ferrara Fire apparatus, Inc. (Ferrara) is recalling certain 2018-2020 Inferno Aerial Fire Apparatus trucks.  In the event of a short circuit or wiring failure, the firmware in the vehicle multiplex system may fail to shut off the output pin, resulting in overloaded electrical circuits.

title: Ducati North America: Incorrectly Installed Passenger Backrest May Break (2,906 affected)
summary: Ducati North America (Ducati) is recalling certain 2016-2023 XDiavel S and XDiavel STD motorcycles.  The passenger backrest may break if it is installed incorrectly or used incorrectly by the passenger.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Transmission Gears May Seize (552 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2023 Toyota GR Supra, 3 Series Sedan (330i xDrive, M340i xDrive, M3), 5 Series Sedan (530i, 530i xDrive, M5), 4 Series Gran Coupe (430i, 430i xDrive), 4 Series Coupe (430i, 430i xDrive, M440i xDrive), 4 Series Convertible (430i, 430i xDrive, M440i xDrive), 8 Series Coupe (840i, M850i xDrive, M8), 8 Series Convertible (840i, M850i xDrive, M8), 8 Series Gran Coupe (850i xDrive, M8), X3 SAV (X3 xDrive30i, X3M), X4 SAV (X4 xDrive30i), X5 SAV (X5 xDrive40i, X5 M50i, X5M), X6 SAV (X6 xDrive40i, X6 M50i, X6M), and Z4 sDrive30i, Z4 M40i vehicles.  The weld seam of the integrated transmission control unit's cover may not have been manufactured properly, which could allow automatic transmission oil to leak into the transmission control unit.

title: Indian Motorcycle Company: Improperly Routed Crankshaft Position Sensor (1,215 affected)
summary: Indian Motorcycle Company (Indian) is recalling certain 2023 Chieftain Elite, 2023-2024 Chieftain Dark Horse, Chieftain Dark Horse Icon, Chieftain Limited, Chieftain, Roadmaster Limited, Roadmaster Dark Horse, Roadmaster, Springfield, Springfield Dark Horse, and 2024 Roadmaster Elite motorcycles. The crankshaft position sensor may have been routed improperly, which can result in an engine stall.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Sunshade Insufficiently Fire Retardant/FMVSS 302 (24,025 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2023-2024 ID.4 vehicles.  The interior sunshade for the panoramic glass roof may be insufficiently fire retardant.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 302, "Flammability of Interior Materials."

title: Keystone RV Company: Incorrect Size Axle Springs Installed (366 affected)
summary: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Dutchmen Coleman 1855RB and 190BH travel trailers.  The trailers may be equipped with axle springs rated at 4400 pounds instead of 5100 pounds.

title: Pierce Manufacturing: Improperly Secured Electrical Connector (314 affected)
summary: Pierce Manufacturing (Pierce) is recalling certain 2019-2023 Arrow XT, Enforcer, and Velocity mid-mount tower trucks equipped  with an aerial platform basket.  The electrical connector to the aerial turntable wiring harness may not be properly secured, which can  result in connector corrosion and affect the leveling ability of the platform basket.

title: Altec Industries, Inc.: Misaligned Welder May Detach from Vehicle (43 affected)
summary: Altec Industries, Inc. (Altec) is recalling certain 2021-2023 CB5-132D-S vehicles equipped with a Bobcat 260 welder installed on a track system.  The welder may be misaligned, preventing the mounting fasteners from being properly tightened.

title: PILOTCAR EV INC.: Red Rear Reflectors May Detach/FMVSS 500 (265 affected)
summary: Pilotcar EV INC. (Pilotcar) is recalling certain 2021-2023 PC-2, PC-4, and PC-6 low speed electric vehicles.  The red rear reflectors may detach from the vehicle.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 500, "Low Speed Vehicles."

title: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini): Incorrectly Adjusted Headlights/FMVSS 108 (7,805 affected)
summary: Lamborghini (Automobili Lamborghini) is recalling certain 2015-2024 Huracan vehicles.  The headlights may be incorrectly adjusted.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: Second-Row Seat Belt Buckle Not Tightened Properly (2,911 affected)
summary: Volvo Car USA, LLC (Volvo Car) is recalling certain 2015-2024 XC90 vehicles.  The second-row seat belt buckle and lower belt anchor bolts may not be tightened properly.

title: Ineos Automotive Americas, LLC: Relay Control Wire May Short Circuit (727 affected)
summary: Ineos Automotive Americas, LLC (Ineos) is recalling certain 2024 Grenadier vehicles equipped with the auxiliary switch package relay.  The relay control wire may have been trapped under the relay power cable connection fastener during assembly, which can potentially damage the relay control wire insulation and result in a short.

title: Sumitomo Rubber USA, LLC: Tire Sidewall May Have Puncture/FMVSS 139 (1,900 affected)
summary: Sumitomo Rubber USA, LLC (Sumitomo) is recalling certain Falken Wildpeak AT3W with size 265/70R17 115T and Wildpeak HT02 with size LT235/85R16 120/116S tires.  Due to a manufacturing error, the tires may have a puncture in the sidewall and leak air.  As such, these tires fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 139, "New Pneumatic Radial Tires for Light Vehicles."

title: PILOTCAR EV INC.: Missing Rearview Camera System/FMVSS 500 & 111 (265 affected)
summary: Pilotcar EV INC (Pilotcar) is recalling certain 2021-2023 PC-2, PC-4, and PC-6 vehicles.  The rearview camera and monitor were not installed.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 111, "Rear Visibility" and 500, "Low Speed Vehicles."

title: PILOTCAR EV INC.: No Pedestrian Warning Sound System/FMVSS 500, 141 (265 affected)
summary: The Pilotcar EV INC (Pilotcar) is recalling certain 2021-2023 PC-2, PC-4, and PC-6 low speed electric vehicles.  The pedestrian warning sound system was not installed.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 141, "Minimum Sound Requirements for Hybrid and Electric Vehicles" and 500, "Low Speed Vehicles."

title: REV Recreation Group: Air Deflector Bracket May Detach from Vehicle (259 affected)
summary: REV Recreation Group (REV) is recalling certain 2016-2023 American Coach American Eagle motorhomes.  Turbulence may loosen or break the rear air deflector mounting bracket hardware.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Insuffeciently Reflective Taillights/FMVSS 108 (30 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024 XLR Boost toy haulers.  The taillights may be insufficiently reflective.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Improperly Secured 12-Volt Ground Connection (164 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2021-2022 GLE350 and GLE450 vehicles.  A 12-Volt ground connection under the driver seat may not be secured properly, resulting in the ground connection overheating.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: Motorcycle Difficult to Control at High Speeds (1,464 affected)
summary: Harley-Davidson Motor Company (Harley-Davidson) is recalling certain 2023 FLHXSE (Street Glide CVO) motorcycles.  The motorcycle may react unexpectedly and become difficult to control when traveling at certain high speeds, especially on rough roads or through wind gusts.

title: Mazda North American Operations: Replacement Air Bag Inflator Incorrectly Installed (12,741 affected)
summary: Mazda North American Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain 2004-2006 B-Series vehicles that received replacement front passenger air bag inflators under a previous recall.  The replacement front passenger air bag inflators may have been installed incorrectly.

title: Tesla, Inc.: Autopilot Controls Insufficient to Prevent Misuse (2,031,220 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling 2012-2023 Model S, 2016-2023 Model X, 2017-2023 Model 3, and 2020-2023 Model Y vehicles equipped with all versions of Autosteer leading up to the version(s) that contains the recall remedy.  In certain circumstances when Autosteer is engaged, the prominence and scope of the feature's controls may not be sufficient to prevent driver misuse of the SAE Level 2 advanced driver-assistance feature.

title: Great Dane Trailers: Loose Axle Spindle Nut May Cause Wheel Detachment (346 affected)
summary: Great Dane Trailers (Great Dane) is recalling certain 2024 Champion trailers.  The axle spindle nut may have been improperly tightened.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: High Voltage Battery May Short Circuit (205 affected)
summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Porsche Taycan, 2021-2022 Taycan 4S, Taycan Turbo S, Taycan Turbo, Taycan 4 Cross Turismo, Taycan 4S Cross Turismo, Taycan Turbo Cross Turismo, 2022 Taycan GTS, and Taycan GTS Sport Turismo vehicles.  The high-voltage battery may experience a short circuit within the battery modules.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: Power Outlet May Cause Charging Cable to Overheat (41,345 affected)
summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling various models and model years.  Please see the recall report for a list of the included vehicles.  When using the industrial 220V/240V plug at the 100% charge setting, some home power outlets may be incapable of handling the electrical current required to utilize the compact charging system, causing the outlet or charging cable to overheat.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Power Outlet May Cause Charging Cable to Overheat (93,196 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2022-2024 RS e-tron GT, e-tron GT, Q4 e-tron Sportback, Q4 e-tron, 2020-2021 Audi A8, 2019-2024 e-tron Quattro, 2020-2024 e-tron Sportback Quattro, Q5, and 2021-2022 A7 vehicles.  When using the industrial 220V/240V plug at the 100% charge setting, some home power outlets may be incapable of handling the electrical current required to utilize the compact charging system, causing the outlet or charging cable to overheat.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Insufficient Interior Joint Strength/FMVSS 221 (321 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Thomas Built SAF-T-LINER C2 and 2024 Thomas Built SAF-T-LINER C2 Jouley school buses.  A rear interior joint between the bulkhead and window panel may have been manufactured incorrectly, resulting in insufficient joint strength.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 221, "School Bus Body Joint Strength."

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Missing Fuse in 12-Volt Battery Cable (106,030 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2020-2022 CR-V Hybrid vehicles.  The 12-Volt battery cable routed outside of the body frame is missing a fuse on the power circuit, which can allow the battery cable to short circuit or overheat during a crash.

title: Hubbell Incorporated (Delaware): Reversed Plug Blades on Electrical Outlet (2,500 affected)
summary: Hubbell Incorporated (Delaware) is recalling certain Wirecon SCD Duplex Receptacles, part number WDRU15WT.  The electrical plug blade openings (narrow hot blade and wider neutral blade) may be reversed on one of the two receptacle outlet faces, which can cause outlet failure.

title: General Motors, LLC: Fire Risk after Seat Belt Pretensioner Deployment (6,771 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2017-2023 Chevrolet Bolt EV vehicles.  This recall includes certain vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under NHTSA recall number 22V-930.  After a crash with seat belt pretensioner deployment, the pretensioner exhaust may ignite carpet fibers near the B-pillar, causing a fire.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Loss of Drive Power from Unsecured Inverter Cable (701 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Thomas Built SAF-T-LINER C2 Jouley electric school buses.  The high voltage inverter cable may not be secured properly, which can result in a loss of drive power.

title: Ford Motor Company: Missing Warning for Turn Signal Failure/FMVSS 108 (189,814 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Maverick vehicles.  In the event that one of the rear turn signals stops working, the vehicle will not adjust the turn signal flash rate frequency to warn the driver that a turn signal is not working correctly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Ford Motor Company: Driver's Air Bag May Become Deactivated/FMVSS 208 (17,970 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023 F-150 and Ford SD F250, F350, F450, F550, and F600 vehicles.  The steering wheel clock spring may have an insufficient weld, causing a loss of electrical connection to the driver's frontal air bag.

title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Loss of Steering Control from Unsecured Strut Bolt (33 affected)
summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2023 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter vehicles.  The front left suspension strut bolt may not be secured properly, which can result in a loss of steering control.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrectly Installed Suspension Air Line (19 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Coachmen Concord CNC321DSF motorhomes.  The air suspension air line may be incorrectly installed near the exhaust, which can cause a sudden loss of rear suspension.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Rear Axle Differential Housing May Break (590 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2022-2023 AMG G63 special edition 4x4² (squared) vehicles.  The rear axle differential housing may develop cracks, possibly resulting in oil leaking onto the roadway or axle failure.

title: Great Dane Trailers: Incorrect VIN on Certification Label/Part 567 (25 affected)
summary: Great Dane Trailers, (Great Dane) is recalling certain 2023 Champion trailers.  The VINs on the certification label may be incorrect.  As such, these trailers fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Incorrectly Adjusted Headlights (10 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2023 EQE 350 vehicles equipped with comfort suspension.  The headlights may be incorrectly adjusted due to a software error in the headlight control unit.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Roof Panel May Detach From Vehicle (2,976 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2014-2020 C-Class, CLA, GLA, S-Class, GLC, and GLE vehicles.  Please refer to MBUSA's recall report for specific vehicle details.  The front roof panel located between the windshield and the panoramic sunroof may not have been bonded correctly to the vehicle during a prior repair, allowing the front panel to detach from the vehicle.

title: Bombardier Recreational Products, Inc.: High-Pressure Fuel Pump May Fail (10,969 affected)
summary: Bombardier Recreational Products, Inc. (Bombardier) is recalling certain 2019-2023 Can-Am Ryker motorcycles.  The impeller may swell, causing the high-pressure fuel pump to fail.

title: Bombardier Recreational Products, Inc.: Rearview Mirror May Detach (1,149 affected)
summary: Bombardier Recreational Products, Inc. (Bombardier) is recalling certain 2023 Can-Am F3 and F3-S motorcycles.  The rearview mirror lens may dislodge from the housing.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Fuel Pump May Fail (2,490,460 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2013-2023 Honda Accord, Civic Coupe, Civic Sedan, Civic Hatchback, Civic Type R, CR-V, HR-V, Ridgeline, Odyssey, Acura ILX, MDX, MDX Hybrid, RDX, RLX, TLX, 2019-2022 Honda Insight, Passport, 2020 Honda CR-V Hybrid, 2018-2019 Honda Clarity PHEV, Fit, and 2015-2020 Honda Accord Hybrid, Pilot, Acura NSX vehicles.  The fuel pump inside the fuel tank may fail.

title: PJ Trailers: Tire Sidewall Separation/FMVSS 119 (4,267 affected)
summary: PJ Trailers is recalling certain 2024 B5, B6, B8, C8, CC, CE, D3, D5, D8, DD, DG, DL, DM, DR, DT, F8, FD, FY, L6, LD, LS, LX, LY, P8, PL, T1, T6, T7, T8, T9, TF, and TJ trailers.  The sidewall of the tires may experience bubbling and separate, causing loss of tire pressure.  As such, these trailers fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 119, "New Pneumatic Tires-Other Than Passenger Cars."

title: R.H. Sheppard Co., Inc.: Steering Gear Assembled Incorrectly (274 affected)
summary: R.H. Sheppard Co., Inc. (R.H. Sheppard) is recalling certain steering gear assemblies, model numbers, HD94P, M100P, HD94S, M110P, M83P, MD83, SD110P, and XD120P.  The steering gear assemblies may have been assembled incorrectly with fewer recirculating balls than are required, which may result in a loss of steering control.

title: Hendrickson USA. L.L.C.: Axle Spindles May Fracture (131 affected)
summary: Hendrickson USA, L.L.C. (Hendrickson) is recalling certain COMPOSILITE EXS20 and SC20 Lift Axles.  The bearing journals may not be fully seated in the steering knuckle assemblies, preventing the proper installation of the wheel end hub assemblies.

title: Van Hool N.V.: Seat Belt Assembly Attachment Screw May Break (64 affected)
summary: Van Hool N.V. (Van Hool) is recalling certain 2024 CX45 vehicles.  The seat belt assembly attachment screw may break.

title: Tesla, Inc.: Doors Can Be Unlocked During a Crash/FMVSS 214 (120,423 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Model S and X vehicles.  The cabin doors can be unlocked during a crash.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 214, "Side Impact Protection."

title: Doosan Bobcat North America, Inc.: Brake Harness Connected Incorrectly (1,799 affected)
summary: Doosan Portable Power (Doosan) is recalling certain 2019-2023 Portable Generator Trailers.  The electric brake harness was connected to the battery disconnect switch instead of the positive distribution lug of the battery, deenergizing the brakes when the battery disconnect switch is in the off position.

title: Airstream, Inc.: Spare Tire Carrier Backet May Break (1,587 affected)
summary: Airstream, Inc. (Airstream) is recalling certain 2012-2023 Basecamp 20X travel trailers.  The spare tire carrier bracket may experience metal fatigue and break, allowing the spare tire to detach from the trailer.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: High-Voltage Battery Modules May Overheat (26,866 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2020-2022 E-Tron Sportback Quattro and 2019-2022 E-Tron Quattro vehicles.  Certain high-voltage battery modules may overheat.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: OCS Sensors May Short Circuit (999,901 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2020-2021 Avalon, Avalon Hybrid, Corolla, Highlander, Highlander Hybrid, RAV4, RAV4 Hybrid, Lexus ES350, Lexus RX350, Lexus RX450H, 2021 Sienna Hybrid, Lexus ES250, 2020-2022 Camry, Camry Hybrid, and ES300H vehicles.  A short circuit may develop in the Occupant Classification System (OCS) sensor, preventing the front passenger air bag from deploying.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Cylinder Head Cover may Crack and Leak Oil (5 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2024 BMW 430i convertible vehicles.  The cylinder head cover may develop cracks, resulting in oil leaking into engine compartment.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Air Bag May Not Deploy Properly/FMVSS 208 (12,575 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Corolla Cross vehicles that were previously inspected at a dealership under recall 23V-384.  The instrument panel may have been produced without the required perforation, which could result in the front-passenger air bag not deploying properly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Front Air Spring Suspension May Separate (9 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2023 LFS buses.  The front air spring suspension hardware may separate from the attachment plate, causing a sudden loss of suspension.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Driver's Seat Air Bag Improperly Mounted/FMVSS 214 (1,001 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2023-2024 SQ8, RSQ8, Q8, Q7, and 2024 SQ7 vehicles.  The driver's seat side air bag may have been improperly mounted to the seatback frame.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 214, "Side Impact Protection."

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Exterior Vehicle Lighting Failure (4,347 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2023 Land Rover Range Rover Sport vehicles.  Moisture may accumulate in the right-side tailgate and body mounted lights, which can cause the right-side exterior vehicle lights, including the brake, outer marker, reversing, and turn indicator lights to fail to illuminate.

title: General Motors, LLC: Door Strikers May Fracture (265 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2024 Chevrolet Blazer, Blazer EV, Equinox, and GMC Terrain vehicles.  The door strikers may fracture, resulting in the door opening unexpectedly.

title: General Motors, LLC: Roof Rail Air Bag Inflators May Rupture (20,712 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2014 Buick Verano and Chevrolet Cruze vehicles.  The left and/or right-side roof-rail air bag (RRAB) inflators may rupture at the inflator weld joint.  This recall is an expansion of Recall 23V-674.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Improperly Bonded Body Panels (29 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2024 Land Rover Range Rover and Land Rover Range Rover Sport vehicles.  The body panels may not be bonded properly, reducing the structural strength of the vehicle.

title: REV Ambulance Group Orlando, Inc.: Overloaded Electrical System May Cause Fire (210 affected)
summary: REV Ambulance Group Orlando, Inc. (REV) is recalling certain 2020-2024 Type I, III and IX vehicles.  In the event of a short circuit or wiring failure, the firmware may fail to shut off the output pin, resulting in overloaded electrical circuits.

title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Crossmember Connection May Loosen (9 affected)
summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2020 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter and Freightliner Sprinter vehicles.  The connection between the propeller shaft bearing and crossmember may loosen, reducing vehicle control.

title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Missing Frame Member Reinforcement Fasteners (3,739 affected)
summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2019-2021 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter and Freightliner Sprinter vehicles.  The longitudinal frame members may be missing reinforcement fasteners, reducing vehicle stability and decreasing the structural integrity of the third-row seats.

title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Partition Wall May Detach (387 affected)
summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2019-2023 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter and 2019-2021 Freightliner Sprinter vehicles.  The partition wall may be missing bolts, allowing the wall to detach during a crash.

title: Kia America, Inc.: Engine Compartment Fire (79,812 affected)
summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2011 Sorento vehicles.  An engine compartment fire can occur while driving.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Improper Seal May Allow Oil and Fuel to Leak (7 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2023 GLC300, 2024 GLE350, and GLE450 vehicles equipped with an M254 engine. The incorrect screws, installed on the high-pressure fuel pump, may prevent a proper seal from forming between the high-pressure fuel pump and the tandem oil pump.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Loss of Drive Power from Unsecured Inverter Cable (26 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2024 Thomas Built SAF-T-LINER C2 Jouley and 2023-2024 FCCC MT50E electric transit buses.  The high voltage inverter cable may not be secured properly, which can result in a loss of drive power.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: Fuel Pump Shutdown May Cause Loss of Drive Power (79,676 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2021-2024 GLE, GLS, C-Class, E-Class, S-Class, SL, GLC, CLS, AMG GT, and G-Class vehicles.  Please refer to MBUSA's recall report for specific vehicle details.  The fuel pump may shutdown, causing a loss of drive power.

title: Carefree Of Colorado: Awning May Extend Unintentionally (8,115 affected)
summary: Carefree Of Colorado (Carefree) is recalling certain Freestyle Gearbox Housing part number: 015933-001.  The gearbox may develop cracks, causing the awning to extend unintentionally.

title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Fuel Pump Shutdown May Cause Loss of Drive Power (13,726 affected)
summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Mercedes-Benz Metris vehicles.  The fuel pump may shutdown, causing a loss of drive power.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: Loose Bolts May Cause A Loss of Steering Control (5 affected)
summary: Nissan North America, Inc. (Nissan) is recalling certain 2024 Altima vehicles.  The bolts connecting the electronic power steering unit to the steering rack may loosen, resulting in a loss of steering control or steering lock-up.

title: Rivian Automotive, LLC: Auto-Hold or Park May Not Activate as Intended (7,873 affected)
summary: Rivian Automotive, LLC (Rivian) is recalling certain 2022 R1T and R1S vehicles.  The accelerator pedal may not detect when the driver releases the pedal, failing to activate "auto-hold" or "park" as intended.

title: Haldex Commercial Vehicle Systems: Inversion Valve Failure/FMVSS 121 (4,717 affected)
summary: Haldex Commercial Vehicle Systems (Haldex) is recalling certain inversion valves.  Please see the attached 573 Defect report for full list of part numbers.  An internal piston in the inversion valve may fail, delaying the engagement of the parking brake.  As such, these valves fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 121, "Air Brake Systems."

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Vehicle Rollaway from Incorrect Gear Shifter (2,547 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain 2024 Freightliner M2 Business Class vehicles.  The vehicle may be incorrectly equipped with a transmission gear shifter that includes a 'PARK' position despite the transmission not having a park pawl.

title: Kia America, Inc.: Side Curtain Air Bags May Deploy Unexpectedly (2,967 affected)
summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2023 Soul and 2024 Seltos vehicles.  Due to a manufacturing error, the side curtain air bags may deploy unexpectedly.

title: Ford Motor Company: Rear Axle Hub Bolt May Break (112,965 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2023 F-150 vehicles equipped with the Trailer Tow Max Duty package and a 9.75-inch heavy duty axle with a 3/4 float axle design.  The rear axle hub bolt may fatigue and break, which can result in damage to the axle hub splines.

title: New Flyer of America, Inc.: Software Error May Cause Unintended Acceleration (246 affected)
summary: New Flyer of America, Inc. (New Flyer) is recalling certain 2021-2023 XE35, XE40 and 2023 XE60 battery electric transit buses.  Due to a software error, unintended acceleration may occur during certain conditions.

title: Ford Motor Company: Engine Oil Pump Failure (139,730 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2016-2018 Ford Focus and 2018-2022 Ford EcoSport vehicles.  The oil pump drive belt or drive belt tensioner may fail, resulting in a loss of engine oil pressure.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Insufficient Illumination from Low Beams/FMVSS 108 (2,369 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2021-2024 BMW R 18B and R 18 Transcontinental motorcycles.  The headlight low beam attachment points may break, shifting the reflector out of position, and resulting in insufficient illumination.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Pedestrian Warning Sound Malfunction/FMVSS 141 (4,926 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2024 i5 eDrive40 and i5 M60 vehicles.  During vehicle start-up, the artificial sound generator control unit may experience a fault and fail to generate the external pedestrian warning sound.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 141, "Minimum Sound Requirements for Hybrid and Electric Vehicles."

title: Volvo Trucks North America: Axle Spindles May Fracture (1 affected)
summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling one 2024 VNL truck.  The bearing journals may not be fully seated in the steering knuckle assembly, preventing the proper installation of the wheel end hub assembly.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: Axle Spindles May Fracture (5 affected)
summary: Mack Trucks, Inc (Mack) is recalling certain 2024 Granite vehicles.  The bearing journals may not be fully seated in the steering knuckle assembly, preventing the proper installation of the wheel end hub assembly.

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Improperly Connected Cable May Overheat (10 affected)
summary: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2024 X3-45 VIP Entertainer motor coaches.  The cable powering the electric radiator cooling fans may be improperly connected and overheat.

title: Prevost Car (US) Inc.: Lift Threshold Warning Lights Insufficient (2,100 affected)
summary: Prevost Car (US) Inc. (Prevost) is recalling certain 2014 and 2018 H3-41, 2013-2024 H3-45, 2012-2024 X3-45, and 2017-2023 X3-45 Commuter vehicles.  The red beacon lighting on the Threshold Warning System (TWS) may not be bright enough.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 403, "Platform Lift Systems."

title: Volvo Bus Corporation: Lift Threshold Warning Lights Insufficient (193 affected)
summary: Volvo Bus Corporation (Volvo Bus) is recalling certain 2013-2021 9700 buses.  The red beacon lighting on the Threshold Warning System (TWS) may not be bright enough.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 403, "Platform Lift Systems."

title: Winnebago Towable: Bumper Mounted Spare Tire Carrier May Detach (1,313 affected)
summary: Winnebago Towable (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Micro Minnie FLX travel trailers.  The spare tire carrier may fail when loaded with a certain off-road style tire.

title: Alamo Group Inc.: Dump Truck Hoist May Fail (195 affected)
summary: Alamo Group Inc. (Alamo) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Old Dominion Brush Company DCL1000SE25, DCL800SM30, DCL800SM25, DCL800SM20, DCL800TM30, DCL800TM25, DCL800TM20, and DCL750 vehicles.  The bolt between the connecting rod and yoke on the hoist can shear, resulting in hoist failure.

title: Daimler Coaches North America: 120-Volt Passenger Outlets May Detach (66 affected)
summary: Daimler Coaches North America (Daimler Coaches) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Tourrider Business and Premium coaches.  The 120-Volt passenger outlets may not be secured properly, allowing them to detach.

title: Rosenbauer America: Overloaded Electrical System May Cause Fire (543 affected)
summary: Rosenbauer America is recalling certain 2020-2022 Avenger, 2017-2024 Commander, 2020-2024 Warrior, 2023 Commercial F-350, F-550, 108SD, and 2024 Commercial 114SD vehicles.  In the event of a short circuit or wiring failure, the firmware may fail to shut off the output pin, resulting in overloaded electrical circuits.

title: New Flyer of America, Inc.: Software Error May Cause Unintended Acceleration (211 affected)
summary: New Flyer of America, Inc. (New Flyer) is recalling certain 2022-2023 XD35, XD40, XN35, XN40, and 2023 XD60, XE35, XE40, and XN60 transit buses.  Due to a software error, unintended acceleration may occur during certain conditions.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: Steering Gear Assembled Incorrectly (284 affected)
summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2024 Anthem, Pinnacle, and Terrapro vehicles.  The steering gear assemblies may have been assembled incorrectly with fewer recirculating balls than are required, which may result in a loss of steering control.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: Steering Gear Assembled Incorrectly (1 affected)
summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling one 2020 VNL truck.  The steering gear assembly may have been assembled incorrectly with fewer recirculating balls than are required, which may result in a loss of steering control.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Engine Compartment Fire from Short Circuit (10,984 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2024 Kona vehicles.  The 12-Volt battery cables may chafe against the engine control module bracket and short circuit during a crash.

title: Battle Motors, Inc.: Drag Link May Become Deformed or Break (1,327 affected)
summary: Battle Motors, Inc. (Battle Motors) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Let2 trucks.  The drag link connecting the steering gear to the roadside steering knuckle may become deformed or break.

title: Cake 0 Emission USA Inc: Lithium-Ion Battery Cells Can Fail While Charging (264 affected)
summary: Cake 0 Emission USA Inc (Cake) is recalling certain 2018-2023 Kalk&, Kalk Ink&, and Kalk :work motorcycles.  The lithium-ion battery cells can fail while charging.

title: Villa International: Incorrect Weld May Cause Seat Failure/FMVSS 207 (35 affected)
summary: Villa International is recalling certain pedestals and seat anchorages, part number 400004.  The pedestal mounting plate may be improperly welded, causing the plate to separate and the seat assembly to loosen or detach.  As such, these seat assemblies fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 207, Seating Systems,", and number 210, "Seat belt assembly anchorages."

title: Ineos Automotive Americas, LLC: Non-Locking Steering Rod Ball Joint Nuts Installed (61 affected)
summary: Ineos Automotive Americas, LLC (Ineos) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Grenadier vehicles.  Non-locking nuts may have been mistakenly installed on the steering rod ball joint.
